issues.description: Course initializer parameter ordering/labels are inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement example and the template define the Course initializer as init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) (see problem_statement.md and template Sources/DeveloperLib/Course.swift), but the solution implementation declares the initializer as init(instructor: String, name: String, ratings: [Int]) (solution Sources/DeveloperLib/Course.swift). The solution's client code instantiates Course using Course(name: ..., instructor: ..., ratings: ...) (solution Sources/DeveloperLib/Client.swift), which does not match the solution initializer signature. This mismatch will confuse students and can lead to compilation errors or prevent the example client code from mapping directly to the implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the Course initializer signature across all artifacts. Prefer changing the solution implementation to match the problem statement and template by declaring init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) and updating any call sites accordingly (or, alternatively, update the problem statement and template to reflect the solution's parameter ordering). Ensure the initializer labels and order are identical in the template, problem statement examples, solution implementation, and any client code so example usage compiles without confusion.
